integration.welcome.rpg.thirst.line2: So you seek to grow stronger... interesting.
integration.welcome.rpg.thirst.line3: And you carry thirst too. Very well.
integration.welcome.rpg.thirst.line5: and will decide how much RPG experience you deserve.
integration.welcome.rpg.thirst.dismiss: Type /aquahungerok in chat to accept the challenge.
integration.welcome.endless.thirst.line2: So you seek to grow stronger... interesting.

integration.welcome.endless.thirst.dismi: Type /aquahungerok in chat to accept the challenge.
integration.welcome.mmo.thirst.line2: You presume to want a superior leveling experience.
integration.welcome.mmo.thirst.line3: And with thirst too. Very well.
integration.welcome.mmo.thirst.line5: and will alter your MMO Skill Tree progress. Good luck.

integration.welcome.unified.thirst.line3: Brave or reckless. We shall see.
integration.welcome.unified.thirst.line5: and will alter all your progress. Good luck.
integration.welcome.unified.thirst.dismi: Type /aquahungerok in chat to accept the challenge.
